source.notes: Frozen extraction manifest for the primary source set: DOI 10.1103/PhysRevLett.110.193601 for H2 v=0 to 1 and DOI 10.1039/D4CP02605E, Table 1, for the H2 v=0 to 2 Q2(0) line. The digest covers the source identifiers, frozen values, uncertainty convention and transformation, not a replacement of the cited publications.

observations.notes: Rotationless H2 fundamental vibrational splitting v=0 to 1, Q(0), from the cited precision spectroscopy source.
H2 first-overtone Q2(0) line position reported to 0.001 cm^-1. The uncertainty is a conservative half-last-reported-digit bound because the cited table does not state a full uncertainty budget.
Comparison-only ratio computed from the two frozen experimental line positions: Q2(0)/Q1(0), with first-order independent uncertainty propagation. No model parameter, fit or calibration was used.

notes: The record was frozen before the isolated comparison was executed; no observation was removed or selected after inspecting residuals.
This is an empirical scope-control dataset for the ideal quantum harmonic-oscillator baseline, not a claim that molecular H2 is an exactly harmonic oscillator.
A deviation from gap_ratio[2]=2 is therefore interpreted as an observed molecular anharmonicity/control outcome, not by itself as a failure of the ideal baseline in its declared scope.
